summary: Frontend re-test of ARCHAUDIT after backend timeout/heartbeat fix (TIMEOUT_SECONDS=20, SSE heartbeats). Full end-to-end flow now completes over the public URL: all three columns (architect, chaos, hardened) reach the loaded state with verdict stamps + latency badges (~20s each, all via deterministic CACHED_FALLBACK because NVIDIA is still hitting the 20s per-stage timeout — expected/spec-approved). Export Report button correctly disabled on load, becomes enabled once hardened is loaded, and clicking it downloads a file named archaudit-report-<ts>.md containing all five required Markdown headings. Sound toggle aria-label flips between 'Mute stamp sound' and 'Unmute stamp sound' with no console errors and does not disrupt the audit. No frontend or integration issues observed.

minor.issue: NVIDIA NIM google/gemma-4-31b-it continues to hit the 20s per-stage timeout in this environment, so every stage lands on the CACHED_FALLBACK mock. Fallback works correctly and the UI still completes end-to-end, but real LLM output is never surfaced. Consider health-checking / swapping the upstream model.

action_items: Optional: investigate why NVIDIA calls consistently exceed 20s in this env (all three stages currently mock-fallback). No blocker for the app; only the LLM quality is affected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: TIMEOUT_SECONDS=20 + SSE heartbeats keep total wall time ~40s comfortably under the ingress limit — good.
App.tsx: On-stream-end safeguard that flips still-loading columns to 'error' is the right defensive move; not exercised in this run because all columns loaded successfully.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all four test cases (full audit, export disabled→enabled, export download+content, sound toggle) passed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything green on public URL https://archaudit-dev.preview.emergentagent.com.
